raw_description:
Position Type: Full-time

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Schedule: EST working hours

ABOUT THE COMPANY

OUR CLIENT IS A PREMIER PROVIDER OF ENGINEERED PROCESS GAS EQUIPMENT USED ACROSS A WIDE RANGE OF INDUSTRIES SUCH AS POWER UTILITY, STEEL, CEMENT, REFINERIES, PULP & PAPER, GLASS, AND CHEMICAL SECTORS AROUND THE GLOBE. RENOWNED FOR THEIR COMMITMENT TO INNOVATION AND EXCEPTIONAL ENGINEERING STANDARDS, THEY CONSISTENTLY DELIVER ADVANCED MECHANICAL AND STRUCTURAL SOLUTIONS TAILORED TO THEIR CLIENTS' NEEDS.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced SolidWorks Mechanical Designer to design and draft process gas equipment including dampers, expansion joints, ductwork, silencers, stacks, and support towers. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to contribute to challenging mechanical and structural engineering projects. You will work closely with the drafting, engineering, and project management teams to ensure all designs are delivered on time and meet stringent functionality and performance requirements.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Create parts, assemblies, and drawings using SolidWorks.
- Modify .dxf and .dwg files using DraftSight.
- Prepare fabrication packages using Adobe and Excel.
- Contribute innovative solutions to complex mechanical and structural design challenges.
- Conduct system design and analysis to ensure functionality and performance meet project requirements.
- Collaborate with drafting, engineering, and project management teams.
- Ensure on-time delivery of all projects.

COMPETENCIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

MUST-HAVE

- 2-3 years of experience in metal fabrication and manufacturing.
- 2-3 years of experience in mechanical and/or structural design.
- 5 years of hands-on experience with SolidWorks.
- Strong knowledge of 3D modeling, focusing on sheet metal components, weldments, and large/complex assemblies with moving parts.
- Experience using AutoCAD or DraftSight.
- Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.

Nice-to-Have

- Experience with advanced sheet metal design and complex weldments.
- Knowledge of mechanical stress analysis or FEA (Finite Element Analysis).
- Familiarity with industry-specific codes and standards beyond basic sheet metal practices.
- Exposure to design for manufacturability (DFM) and assembly processes.
- Experience collaborating with international clients or multi-disciplinary engineering teams.
- Basic programming or automation experience in SolidWorks (DriveWorks and macros).

Key Qualities

- Versatile: Able to adapt to various mechanical and structural design challenges while maintaining accuracy and quality.
- Innovative: Brings creative, practical solutions to complex engineering problems.
- Collaborative: Demonstrates effective communication with multiple departments and other team members to achieve project goals.
- Diligent: rigorous and thorough to ensure designs meet functional, safety, and performance requirements.
- Meticulous: Works meticulously in producing clear and concise documentation that adheres to all drafting processes and standards.
- Timely: Capable of working in a fast-paced environment and delivering projects accurately and on-time.
- Proud: Possesses a sense of great pride for delivering high-quality documentation and products to our fabrication teams and customers.

WHAT WE OFFER

- 100% Remote Work - Work from anywhere in the Philippines.
- Career Growth Opportunities - Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning.
- Collaborative & Innovative Team - Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence.

APPLICATION PROCESS

We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and we're here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible.

The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us.
